appliedenhancements.config.max_crafting_:
Select the crafting order handling mode.
Native AE2: leave AE2's native handling untouched.
Up to 64-bit Integer Limit: enable the long-valued path up to Long.MAX_VALUE (9223372036854775807).
Arbitrary-Precision Quantities: also enable exact orders above Long.MAX_VALUE.
Default: Native AE2 (DISABLED)
appliedenhancements.config.enable_patter:
Cache pattern input validation and container-return lookups. Significantly improves large crafting calculations.
Default: true
appliedenhancements.config.pattern_cache:
Maximum multi-key cache entries retained per pattern. Limits memory use while preserving useful cache diversity.
Range: 8 ~ 256
Default: 32
appliedenhancements.config.enable_enhanc:
Enable enhanced material calculation in the crafting preview to show accurate missing, stored, and crafting item counts.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.enable_storag:
Index candidate slots during AE2's existing external-inventory scan. Cached slots are revalidated; incomplete results fall back to AE2's full scan.
Default: true
appliedenhancements.config.enable_infini:
Allow unlimited extraction and planning supply for explicitly marked infinite cells. Only keys accepted by the mounted cell's extraction checks are supplied; finite cells are unchanged. Disable to preserve the original cell behavior and reported quantities.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.enable_io_bus: Optimize Import and Export Bus Slot Routing

Reuse validated source and target slot hints for AE2 import and export buses. Incomplete operations fall back to AE2's original slot routing.
Default: true
appliedenhancements.config.enable_progre:
Show crafting calculation progress and the selected planner path.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.enable_automa:
Enable automatic AELIS integration in AE2's native planner. Third-party API calls are not affected. Manual crafting-plan inventory reservations are active only while this is enabled.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.enable_aelis_:
Use exact BigInteger arithmetic for AELIS orders and intermediate demands above Long.MAX_VALUE. Long projections are for compatibility; CPUs decide execution and can read the exact execution API. When disabled, automatic AELIS uses legacy long arithmetic; explicit exact API requests remain exact.
Default: true
appliedenhancements.config.aelis_max_nod:
Maximum nodes analyzed by AELIS per attempt. Higher values allow more complex recipes but use more memory.
Range: 1000 ~ 1000000
Default: 100000
appliedenhancements.config.aelis_compile:
Compilation budget in milliseconds for each AELIS attempt. Limits time spent analyzing the crafting tree before execution.
Range: 100 ~ 30000
Default: 2000
appliedenhancements.config.aelis_diagnos:
Enable diagnostic logging only in integrations that read this compatibility setting. Applied Enhancements itself does not emit development or temporary planning traces.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.cycle_solver_:
Maximum material nodes in one strongly connected component (SCC).
Range: 4 ~ 1024
Default: 256

Maximum branch-search states for multi-candidate cyclic components.
Range: 1000 ~ 10000000
Default: 1000000

Maximum time in milliseconds spent by one global or local cyclic solve.
Range: 10 ~ 5000
Default: 1000
appliedenhancements.config.cycle_seed_po:
Select how cycle startup materials are handled after the proven cycle schedule finishes.
Preserve Minimum Seeds: keep the minimum seed vector for the next order.
Maximum Throughput: allow the current order to consume every cycle material.
Default: Preserve Minimum Seeds (PRESERVE_MINIMUM)
appliedenhancements.config.enable_aelis_:
Use the AELIS crafting-plan screen on this client. Disable to use AE2's original confirmation screen without changing planning or execution.
Default: true
